get_tools_list: get all available tools including local tools, OpenAPI tool servers, and MCP tool servers with access control filtering
create_new_tool: create a new tool by uploading Python code content with a valid identifier and storing it in the database and in-memory cache
update_tool_by_id: update an existing tool's code content, metadata, and specs by ID with access control validation
delete_tool_by_id: delete a tool from the database and remove it from the in-memory TOOLS cache by its ID
update_tool_valves: update tool-level configuration valves (admin settings) for a tool by ID using Pydantic schema validation
